rules: Never derive objective satisfaction solely from queue DONE.
Never treat provider output as independent outcome evidence.
Never derive product observation truth from governance PASS.
Never omit unknown lifecycle states from visible counts or triage.
Never let parallel schedulers/recovery writers gain authority by convention.
Never use Date.parse finiteness as proof of a real unambiguous calendar timestamp.
Never treat non-ESRCH process-probe errors as a dead owner.
Validate serialized bytes before append; validating a pre-serialization object is insufficient.
Never suppress corrupt ledger rows and return partial healthy state.
Never use another execution revision's tests or soak as current closure.
